description: This C# source file contains a benchmarking class 'GrainStorageBenchmark' that measures the performance of various grain storage backends in an Orleans test environment. It includes methods for setting up different storage configurations, running performance tests asynchronously, collecting and reporting metrics, as well as internal configurator classes for each storage type.

classes.name: GrainStorageBenchmark
classes.description: A class responsible for benchmarking different grain storage providers by performing read/write operations and measuring their performance.

classes.name: SiloMemoryStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for setting up in-memory grain storage in the Orleans silo.

classes.name: SiloAzureTableStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for setting up Azure Table Storage in the Orleans silo with specified options.

classes.name: SiloAzureBlobStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for setting up Azure Blob Storage in the Orleans silo with specified options.

classes.name: SiloAdoNetStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for setting up ADO.NET grain storage in the Orleans silo with specified options.

methods.name: MemorySetup
methods.description: Initializes and deploys an Orleans test cluster configured for in-memory grain storage.

methods.name: AzureTableSetup
methods.description: Initializes and deploys an Orleans test cluster configured for Azure Table storage.

methods.name: AzureBlobSetup
methods.description: Initializes and deploys an Orleans test cluster configured for Azure Blob storage.

methods.name: AdoNetSetup
methods.description: Initializes and deploys an Orleans test cluster configured for ADO.NET storage.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Performs the benchmarking asynchronously, running multiple concurrent tasks to simulate load and collecting performance metrics.

methods.name: RunAsync (overload)
methods.description: Executes repeated grain storage operations until a stopping condition, collecting individual operation reports.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Stops all silos in the test cluster, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the test cluster resources if they exist.
